notes: eb0459de7a (Tanya Yiddish '23 P6-7'): the file appears to join two shiur sessions. The first ends near 61:15 with a sign-off. The second starts after a Yom Tov break, cites the Rebbe's sichah of Shabbos Kedoshim 5736 and re-reads the end of chapter 6. It may correspond to two separate lecture numbers in the series.
eb0459de7a opens mid-answer to a question, so the start may be truncated.

Date: Shabbos Kedoshim 5736 = 22 Iyar 5736 (1976-05-22), so the second session is late Iyar or Sivan 5736. This fits sibling shiurim 28 (29 Av 5736) and 29 (Elul 5736). Possible continues/part_of_set links to shiurim 22 and 24 of the same series were not visible in this batch; pass 2 can add them.
Proposed new people term: Rabbi Gershon Kitover (the Baal Shem Tov's brother-in-law).
